summary.text: Anthony Oberman is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 15 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Harold Slager. A retired police officer, he describes himself as a lifelong Northwest Indiana resident.

paragraphs.text: Oberman graduated from Crown Point High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana State University in 2007.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a husband, father of two daughters and retired police officer who grew up in a union household.
Oberman advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, with 3,778 votes in an uncontested race.

He said he is running to focus on affordability, public education, public safety and defending the middle class, and his first listed campaign message was protecting families and keeping communities safe.
